 Discover thousands of Hiking trails

You’ll find thousands of accommodation and amenity options for your adventures. Plan ahead with the perfect lunch spot, campsite, resupply town or maybe even a 5-star hotel on your hiking trip. 

 Create your own custom trail 
The HiiKER Trail Planner will enable you to blaze your own trail and plan a custom hike. You can share all trails with your adventure crew so that everyone is prepared for the hike. 

 Import GPX files 
Got a GPX file of an awesome hiking trail from a friend or other source? Import it to HiiKER and make your own edits to the route before hitting the trail. 

 Track your Hikes 
The HiiKER GPS Tracker records your hiking activity and gives you in-depth detail about your walks that you can share with your adventure crew. Got an ultra run you want to record?  Offline Maps 
With HiiKER PRO you can download all your favourite hiking trails to your phone to use offline - even in airplane mode. This is perfect for those hiking adventures where cell service is not guaranteed. It is also much less intensive on your battery life, meaning you can use it for longer!

 Measure the Distance
